notes.title: Birthday release: Mac build is out!
notes.notes: [p][b]It's been exactly a year since Master of Chess went into Early Access![/b] 🥳🎉🎂[/p][p][/p][p]It's incredible to see how far it went since then. 6k+ players. 200 reviews. Not bad for a first commercial game and a one-man team. [/p][p][/p][p]I often think how much it could have been better if I could redo it, but I'm still extremely happy with how well it improved over time. By my count, I've released 32 new builds in the last year. [/p][p][/p][p]Lets introduce the last build of the game before it turns 1 year old:[/p][p][/p][h2]New Build[/h2][p]Most importantly, I've started to support Macs. It did require some work but since I've switched my primary workstation to a mac laptop it made sense to support it now. I can test and build there.[/p][p][/p][p]Other than that, it's same-all, same-all: bug fixes and small improvements all around:[/p][list][*][p]Fix issue with openings not being saved after Quit to Menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix annoying issue with screens switch when game is loaded.[/p][/*][*][p]Allow saving of custom db saves when the db deletes players.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix skipped messages bug.[/p][/*][*][p]Add setup for board look config.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]What's coming next[/h2][p]I've already hinted it with the previous part, but board configuration is the next feature I'm adding. I've initially been against it but since it was often requested and it is fun to implement I've finally decided to invest the time and bring it in as a core part of the game. [/p][p][/p][p]Other than that, the game is mostly feature complete. As far as bigger features go: I'd like to have 'Play a match' & 'Solve a puzzle' action straight from opening menu. No need for you to enter your career save.[/p][p]Then it's mostly about usability fixes and bug hunting and voila:[/p][p]The game is couple of months away from going out of early access![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for support and keep the comments/bug reports/reviews coming.[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers![/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: The Huge Update
notes.notes:
The most exciting batch of changes for Master of Chess is done!

Yes, there's still a lot more work to be done, but I'm getting there and I have a feeling that the hardest things are behind me now. [b]Due to amount of changes, there's a high possibility of bugs.[/b] Please report them on [url=https://discord.gg/HYV8Zz8V2Q]Discord [/url]or in community 🙏.

I plan to release the game out from Early Access in couple of months. What's the biggest problem you have with the game? What's missing? Let me know so I can get it in before the 1.0.0 release!

[h1]Changes[/h1]

I've covered all the bigger changes in previous blogs so I'll just go out and list out all the changes I've remembered to record. 

[h2]🛠️ Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix AI logic on recaptures
[*] Fix negamax crash
[*] Fix bug with puzzles and progress points
[*] Fix issue with female title tooltips
[*] Fix issue with puzzle coach explanations
[*] Fix message icon for tournaments starting
[*] Fix bug with turning sound off
[*] Fix bugs with progress screen progress assignment
[*] Improve draw offer criteria
[/list]

[h2]➕ Features & Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Allow saving mid-game
[*] Add coaches
[*] Add openings
[*] Add auto-save after a game
[*] Add tutorials for new features
[*] Add translations
[/list]

[h2]🎮 Gameplay & Logic[/h2]
[list]
[*] Return entry fee on tournament withdrawal
[*] Improve AI consideration for recapture
[/list]
[h2]🎨 UI/UX & Design[/h2]
[list]
[*] UX improvements
[*] Player Details modal
[*] Font consolidation
[*] Some UI changes
[/list]

[h2]🔊 Audio[/h2]
[list]
[*] SFX (sound effects)
[/list]

[h3]What's next[/h3]

One thing I've learned through these past months is that I enjoy much more to have the updates in smaller batches and delivered faster. I'll do my best to keep the update cadence better in upcoming months.

One thing to note is that I've been spending time helping a friend to release his detective game. Please wishlist it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2797960/Confidential_Killings/

notes.title: Stop the blunders! New demo version is out!
notes.notes:
[b]It's 2024, it's the year MoC comes out.[/b] And if everything goes well it should be out in couple of months. It's weird writing those words when there's so much more to do, but I'm excited for it. Future is bright!

If you want to talk chess or game development, join here: https://discord.gg/HYV8Zz8V2Q.

[img]https://www.imbrane.com/assets/images/moc-78f06b3418d12a36ddb6b04606de5623.gif[/img]

[h1]What's new?[/h1]
It's been so long since last demo version that it's hard for me to list out what has changed. Better question would be: what hasn't!? You'll find threats detection feature (you'll know it when you see it), a much improved AI, more polished UI, improvements in UX, more translations. Everything changed. (for the better, I hope!)

[h1]What's gone?[/h1]
I've added as much as I've removed to deliver a more focused and polished version of the demo. So the demo no longer contains:

[list]
[*] 📰 Separate Tutorial screen. It's now built in the first match.
[*] 🤵 Player creation process. I wanted to let the player see the game in action as soon as possible. You're immediately presented with pre-created player from France - Matteo Martin.
[*] 🔑 Key Moments simulation. I don't have good explanation why, it just was too buggy after I added many AI improvements in the game and I decided to cut it out for a moment.
[/list]

[h1]What's the plan?[/h1]
There's two threads I'm trying to follow.

First and foremost I'm looking into creating an alpha build of MoC. There's plenty of work to do, but I think I'm getting close. It will be rough, but it will be first real insight into the full game.

Secondly,[b] I'm working on releasing a completely free app about chess opening repertoire creation[/b]. When folks saw the opening graph screenshots, a lot of comments were about how they would be interested in something like that, even if it was standalone. Now they can have it!

So a lot more work left. Check out the new demo and let me know what you think!

notes.title: Massive update alert: Counting Down to Steam Release
notes.notes:
Today is a great point in development of MoC: [b]Demo is feature complete[/b].

Today I've uploaded a new build of Master of Chess demo. If you're interested in testing it, join discord here: https://discord.gg/HYV8Zz8V2Q

Is it perfect? No. Is it bug-free? No way. But it's a valid reference point to what the demo will look like when it hits Steam. 

[img]https://www.imbrane.com/assets/images/create-player-900d8cd4a131044639ed94a6001565f3.gif[/img]

[h2]The Latest and Greatest: What's New in the Demo?[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Create your player[/b] feature is integrated completely. Feel free to start up the demo and create your own player.
[*] [b]Match preview screen[/b] got a complete overwrite. The placeholder UI is now replaced with a full overview of both players strengths and winning percentages.
[*] [b]'Game crashes randomly'[/b] bug fixed! (or so I hope, I can't reproduce it any more!) It seems to be related to the way async code was handled in Godot and in the newest version 4.1 I had to switch the way async code is handled and even clear out some of the async logic.
[*] As mentioned, [b]game is now migrated to beta version of Godot 4.1[/b]. We're running it bleeding edge as far as Godot is concerned. I'm really happy that Godot will hit stable 4.1 in the approximately same time as my game starts seeking stability too.
[*] [b]A linux build![/b] I decided to have a linux build because a) people asked for it, b) I hoped it would give me more insights into some game-crashing bugs. 
[*] Numerous little bug fixes and tidy ups. I plan to write this up in a more professional manner in the future so I can list those out easily. 
[/list]

[h2]A Few Dragons Still to Slay: Current Issues[/h2]

[list]
[*]  [b]Chess AI Improvements:[/b] Chess AI received a lot of comments, with some finding it too challenging and others finding it not challenging enough. This feedback isn't contradictory; it points to the inconsistencies in the AI, which I'm aware of. Over the next week (and even month), refining the AI will be a major focus of my work.
[*] [b]Enhancing User Interface:[/b] The user experience on the match review screen isn't the best. Navigating through a completed match should be a breeze, and I agree that there's room for improvement. I'm committed to making this experience better. Some UX issues, bugs still exist on the main match screen too. These need to be addressed.
[*] [b]AI Responsiveness Issues:[/b] Some of you have encountered a problem where the AI stops making moves. This was an issue I tackled in early builds, but it seems to have reappeared. It's time I dive into it and ensure it's permanently fixed.
[/list]


[h3]What's next?[/h3]

As mentioned, the Demo is feature complete and all that's left is to polish it up. If I could get the AI to be decent enough in the next week and add some Quality of Life improvements then all would be ready for a Steam release of the Demo in early July.

I'm so excited!
